description.value: Yellow Point Park is a nature reserve on Vancouver Island near Ladysmith, managed by the Cowichan Valley Regional District. It sits within a region popular with touring cyclists for its quiet roads and coastal scenery. As a CVRD-operated natural area, it offers a potential rest or exploration stop along routes through the Cowichan Valley.
